authors: Jiarui Ge; Jintao Ma; Bangxu Fan; Jinyan Zhang; Xiaokang Yang; Shuai Na; Xiaoyun Yuan

summary_en: Introduces PAGS, a differentiable blind-autofocusing framework for PACT that represents the initial pressure field with sparse Gaussian sources and models heterogeneous propagation using a compact anisotropic path-averaged speed-of-sound field. An analytic Gaussian acoustic projection enables efficient signal-domain optimization of both image and propagation parameters, improving reconstruction sharpness without calibrated SoS priors.
